class.name: WeatherSoundEffect
class.brief_description: Rain, wind and thunder sound for a [Weather] node, synthesized in the engine.
class.description: Plays the weather's sound in game (not in the editor's preview). The sounds are synthesized from noise once per run, on worker threads, so the engine ships no audio files: light and heavy rain on open ground, wind with gusts, and five thunder claps (far rumbles and near cracks). Put your own recordings in the [b]Own Sounds[/b] slots to replace them; clearing a slot brings the synthesized sound back. Rain and wind sounds are made to loop (on a copy; your resource stays as it is). Light and heavy rain crossfade as the rain gets heavier. The wind sound follows the wind speed at the camera, gusts included, up to full loudness at [member wind_full_speed]. Thunder answers every [signal Weather.lightning_struck] after the time sound takes to travel the distance (343 m/s): near strikes crack, far ones only rumble, through a low-pass filter and a reverb on the [code]WeatherThunder[/code] audio bus, which the effect creates while it runs and sends to [member audio_bus].

method.name: get_pending_thunder_count
method.description: Thunder claps still on their way (lightning seen, sound not yet arrived).

method.name: get_rain_amount
method.description: The rain loudness this frame, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]: the weather's rain amount.

method.name: get_wind_amount
method.description: The wind loudness this frame, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]: the wind speed at the camera over [member wind_full_speed].

method.name: is_ready
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once the synthesized sounds are in the players. They take a second or two after the first start in a run.

method.name: synthesize
method.description: Synthesizes one of the built-in weather sounds and returns it as a new [AudioStreamWAV] (44.1 kHz, 16-bit mono; rain and wind loop). The same [param sound] is the same every time. Takes a few hundred milliseconds; use it to play the weather's sounds elsewhere, for example from an [AudioStreamPlayer3D].

members.member: The audio bus the weather's sound plays on, for example an ambience bus.
Your own heavy rain loop, faded in over the light rain as the rain gets heavier. Empty: the synthesized heavy rain.
Your own sharp, cracking thunder for near strikes, one picked at random. Empty: the synthesized near thunder.
Your own light rain loop. Empty: the synthesized light rain.
Volume trim of the rain, on top of [member volume_db].
Your own thunder for far and middle-distance strikes, one picked at random. Empty: the synthesized far thunder.
Volume trim of the thunder, on top of [member volume_db].
Volume of all the weather's sound.
The wind speed at which the wind sound is at full loudness.
Your own wind loop. Empty: the synthesized wind.
Volume trim of the wind, on top of [member volume_db].

constants.constant: Light rain on open ground (a loop).
Heavy rain with a low roar (a loop).
A near thunder crack with a boom and rumble, 9 seconds.
A near thunder crack with a boom and rumble, 10 seconds.
